baseline_checks.javascript_api: PASS JavaScript API: real engine parity, ambiguity/refusal, delivery profiles, offline default, opt-in Wikipedia fixtures, sessions, imports, validation, readiness and error recovery.

findings: Existing browser and native APIs already use the full reader. A URL alone does not expose private browser storage.
Optional Node bridge needs browser automation for live calls and manually supplied corpus/session arguments.
No local MCP tool server, MCP session lifecycle, host collection scope or MCP client conformance test exists at this revision.
Local trusted-operator use is the declared deployment scope. Shared service authentication, tenant isolation and independent language/usability validation are not established.
